1.consolidated_definition: Celador, vigilante. Empleado que vigila edificios, en uso o vacíos, de día o de noche. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. El wachimán de mi cuadra duerme tan profundo, que hace unos días entraron a robar y no se dió cuenta (Tu babel, consultado 16-06-09)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Night watchman, caretaker. Employee who guards buildings, whether in use or vacant, during the day or night. Anglicism adapted, relatively infrequent. The wachimán from my neighborhood sleeps so soundly that a few days ago thieves broke in and he didn't even notice (Your Babel, consulted 16-06-09)
